functions.openCase: openCase(caseIdOrScenarioRef,{snapshot?,assumptions?}={}) -> envelope + case + objects + evidence + public_context + assumptions + resources + linked_cases + snapshot_id + disclosure
functions.analyzeCase: analyzeCase(caseIdOrScenarioRef,{snapshot?,assumptions?}={}) -> envelope + case_id + scenario_ref + case_type + metrics[] + risks[] + missing_inputs[] + explanation + constraints[] + outcome_status + priority + models
functions.compareCaseActions: compareCaseActions(caseIdOrScenarioRef,{snapshot?,assumptions?,commitments?}={}) -> envelope + analysis + actions[] + baseline_action_id + practical_rule_action_id + recommended_action_id + frozen_conditions + shared_resource_state + limitations
functions.reopenDecisionRecord: reopenDecisionRecord(record) -> envelope + record + saved analysis + saved comparison + reproduces_saved_basis
functions.reconstructState: reconstructState(versionRecords,{knowledge_as_of,world_time,knowledge_mode:'system_known'|'public_known',allow_availability_proxy?}) -> records + excluded + clocks + status; synthetic_snapshot is not a historical knowledge mode

commitment.case_id: case owning the prior sandbox plan

commitment_rules: Pass resource_claims from a feasible action, not a user-built reduction of its needs.
Commitments are a local bounded sandbox only; saving a human choice does not mutate baseline inventory/cash or execute anything.
One cash/stock/role/fuel/storage/transport/backup-energy ledger is checked for every case.

persistence.checksum: FNV-1a 32-bit reproducibility/integrity check; not authentication or a cryptographic signature

baseline_policy: Each case includes no_action and practical_rule; unknown cases defer quantified advice and retain missing-input reasons.
recommendation_limits: Supply compares feasible conditional costs. Other workflows provide feasible operational choices; no learned or globally optimal policy is claimed. Feasible partial continuity can still have an explicitly shown gap.
empirical_validation: Not established for MR. DIY. External benchmark manifests and rows remain separate. Functional fixture tests cannot pass AC11/AC12.
integration_requirements: Add both new Worker files to the flattening build module list before the consuming service.
Expose JSON asset only with its synthetic disclosure and data-mode badges.
Retain public_context separately from operational evidence and hypothetical events.
Use validateMrdiySnapshot, not the existing unrelated validateSnapshot binding.
Keep modules pure; all persistence and UI routes are canonical integration work.
